subject: Opening the Locket
body:
You have the Locket, Artist. It will not open by hand. Set it in a Fusion Shrine with a Moonstone Core, 16 White Pigment and a Kraken Tooth. Moonstone Cores are kept in Forgotten City vaults; the tooth comes from the Kraken.

Open the Locket and you get the Compass. Follow it. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:pastel_locket @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/locket
